quotes.summary_phrase: Quenton Jackson on his development from the G League to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I just think that's just a steady diet of what I've been fed in life.

text_blocks.speaker: Quenton Jackson
text_blocks.text: I just think that's just a steady diet of what I've been fed in life. Having to go the long way, having to take a couple extra steps to get to where I need to be. As I've gotten older, obviously matured, I've been able to see tendencies in my life. And so, you know, that's just that fire from just wanting. I just want to be. And then when I put my mind to it, I just got to make it happen. And that's the only way it's going to happen. So, you know, I just attack everything at 100 percent. That way, if you fail, you know, you can dial it back some.

text_blocks.speaker: Quinn Buckner
text_blocks.text: What fit you wearing? Which one are you hot on now? You know, you go through phases, everybody goes through phases.
